title: Quri vaca qallut jaqunukut jaqi
intro: Quran qillqatan arsut mä chimpux walja jaqinakarux desviación ukar irpxaruwayi, kunawsatix mä jach’a profetax jan utjkän ukhaxa. Kunatix qurit lurat ukax mä taqpach markan chuymap katjatayna — ukampis aka jaqin sarnaqäwipax sapakïñamp ukat mä muspharkañ maldición ukamp tukuyi. ¿Khitis uka jaqunukut jaqejj utjaspa?
clues: Mä jachʼa profetajj jan utjkäna ukhaw uñstawayta, jupajj Diosan irpañapatakiw alajjpachar saräna.
Nayajj amparajampi lurat kunanaktï lurawaykta ukampiw walja jaqenakarojj pantjasiyawayta.
Nayan lurat qorit lurat yänakajj jakañanïkaspas ukhamänwa, uka arunak arkirinakarojj hipnotizapkäna uka sonidonak lurasa.
Nayax kuntix mayninakax jan amuyapkaspa uk uñjta sasaw sista — jan uñjat mä juk’a uñtawi.
Diosan khithanit pʼeqenakapat kuns apsuyäta ukat chullut metalar jaqontayäta.
Sapak sarnaqañajatakiw juchañchatäyäta, mä jan uñtʼat maldicionampi, janiw khitis ñikʼutaj llamktʼkaspati, janirakiw nayas jupanakan janchipar llamktʼirjamäkti.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Mä thujru, ukax mä katariruw tukuwayi
Mä qullun nina nakhaskir ch’uxña quqa
Mä arcajj mä pico patjjan samartʼaski

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Jaqunukuta, mayninakar llamkt’añatakisa jan ukax llamkt’añatakisa jark’atawa
Mä ejercitomp chikaw qutan umamp chhaqhata
Perdonata ukat jach’a estación ukar jiltayata
outcome.answer: Jaqunukuta, mayninakar llamkt’añatakisa jan ukax llamkt’añatakisa jark’atawa

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
